# `src/components/ui/`

**shadcn/ui** components (Base UI + Tailwind). Generated by the CLI — **source of truth** for button, input, sheet, dropdown, etc.

## Add a component

```bash
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add <component-name>
```

## Do not

- Copy-paste alternate implementations of the same primitive without team agreement.
- Remove accessibility attributes added by the generator.

## Styling

Components use design tokens from **`src/app/globals.css`** and Tailwind v4. Prefer **`cn()`** from **`@/lib/utils`** when composing classes in wrappers.
